title: The Agentic Information Economy
gist: Shuwei Fang argues information is undergoing a category change from something people consume to something AI agents act on, so errors become consequential actions; an agent-run internet needs an information ecology that questions its inputs and propagates corrections, beyond better data or human-in-the-loop fixes.

insights.claim: Information is shifting from something people consume to something machines act on, so errors will stop being mere digital impressions and become actions with far-reaching consequences.
insights.speaker: SHUWEI FANG
insights.so_what: Raises the liability and value of data accuracy in agentic workflows; data provenance, verification and correction services gain importance.
insights.quote: errors will stop being mere digital impressions and start becoming actions with far-reaching consequences
insights.locator: Information is undergoing a category change

insights.claim: An internet run by AI agents will need a broader information ecology that can question its own inputs and transmit corrections wherever needed when information changes, not just reliable data.
insights.speaker: SHUWEI FANG
insights.so_what: Suggests a market for correction-propagation and data-lineage infrastructure feeding agents (e.g., update/recall mechanisms for facts).
insights.locator: An internet populated and run by AI agents

insights.claim: Better data or putting a human back in the loop will not be sufficient safeguards for an agent-driven information economy; the system will need safeguards of its own.
insights.speaker: SHUWEI FANG
insights.so_what: Challenges the common enterprise assumption that human review solves agent risk; favors system-level controls.
insights.quote: Better data or putting a human back in the loop will not suffice.
insights.locator: Information is undergoing a category change

insights.claim: Whether the agentic information economy ends up serving private interests or the public good remains an open question.
insights.speaker: SHUWEI FANG
insights.so_what: Governance of agentic information infrastructure is an emerging regulatory battleground to watch.
insights.quote: whether this will serve private interests or the public good remains to be seen
insights.locator: An internet populated and run by AI agents
